skills.name: ros-claw/inspire_rh56_hand_gestures
skills.description:
Demonstrates Inspire Robots RH56 series dexterous hand control over
RS485/Modbus RTU. v2.1 adds strict force-closed-loop self-evolution:
FORCE_ACT baseline audit, exclusive contact-event schema, asymmetric
OK contact search, force-curve decay analysis, human/visual shape labels,
repeatability gating, and promotion of an ok_contact_safe_v2 policy.
The skill records practice episodes, updates body cognition, and reports
honest promotion/rejection status.
Also includes an example Rock-Paper-Scissors game where the hand counts
down 3-2-1 with its own gestures and plays against a human hand detected
via a ROS 2 / RealSense camera.

skills.name: rosclaw/realsense_camera_usage
skills.description: RealSense camera usage skill: enumerate cameras, check status, capture RGB/depth frames, and report basic health for D405 / D435i setups.

skills.name: ros-claw/realsense_ops
skills.display_name: RealSense Operations Discipline (lifecycle, wedge recovery, USB topology)
skills.description:
Operational discipline for Intel RealSense D400 cameras on production rigs
(Jetson / x86 Linux), distilled from field incidents on the ROSClaw
dual-RH56 rig through 2026-08-03.  Complements the executable capture
skill `realsense_capture_rgbd` (which takes pictures) and the community
`realsense-troubleshoot` guide (generic app debugging) — this skill is
about NOT killing the camera or the USB host controller while running
long streaming sessions, and about recovering correctly when the bus
wedges anyway.  Includes scripts/realsense_doctor.py: one-shot
enumeration + controller-topology + dmesg-signature diagnosis with an
escalation-ordered recovery recommendation.

skills.name: ros-claw/ros_install
skills.description: Install, verify, or repair a ROS / ROS 2 environment on the host workstation. Uses the official ros2-apt-source flow with typed HostOps plans.
